decisions.statement: Nothing playing already and no device to play on refuses the call.
A uri named plays that exact track and searches for nothing.
A uri naming no track is played exactly as the uri was written.
A query named beside a uri refuses the call.
Neither a query nor a uri refuses the call.
An empty query or an empty uri is refused rather than acted on.
A device named on the command line is played on rather than the active device.
A call that started playback and then refused says playback started.
A play Spotify took but answered badly is said here to have not started.

definition: the command playing one track, named by a query or by a track uri
